text:
Ana (support): LuminaCare (org-lumina-42) just pinged—they have a large demo starting in 30m and their traffic is spiking. They want a temporary quota/limit override in eu-west-2. @Devon can we do a quick check? 
capacity-bot: ALERT eu-west-2 GPU pool 95% saturated | queue=480 | avg_wait=22s | inflight=128 | backpressure=ON
Devon (eng-sre): Looking. Their demo is hitting many long-context chat models which kills KV cache locality. Queueing is already triggering admission control.
Devon (eng-sre): @Ajay any spare capacity in other regions we can failover to without violating LuminaCare's data residency request? They said EU-only.
Ajay (eng-infra): EU-only unfortunately. eu-west-1 has a few free GPUs but network egress and private-link wiring to their VPC is not provisioned for this org, would take ~1h to route. Also cross-region would add ~80-120ms latency per request, risks demo SLOs.
Mike (sales): Customer is on a paid pilot, demo today is high chance to convert. Need temporary override for 2h to avoid throttling. What's minimal change we can make fast?
Devon (eng-sre): We can do a temporary raise of admission.max_inflight_per_org for org-lumina-42 and bump their token/sec quota by 2x for 2 hours. That will increase GPU pressure but should clear queue gradually. Need approvals from infra and cost signoff.
Rebecca (customer-success): I'll tell the customer we are working the escalation. Please confirm expected queue reduction and if any impact to other tenants.
Ajay (eng-infra): Quick numbers: 2x rate may push eu-west-2 to >98% and increase preemption risk for dedicated customers. Prefer to do targeted override on per-model admission to limit blast radius.
Devon (eng-sre): Proposed command to apply temporary override:
```
# apply override for org-lumina-42
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/redwood/overrides \
  -d '{"org_id":"org-lumina-42","overrides":{"token_rate":200,"max_inflight":60},"duration":"2h","reason":"LuminaCare Q1 demo"}' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
Ana (support): I've opened Zendesk ticket #Z-198412 and linked the customer. Added @Mike for approval and @Ajay for infra guardrails.
Mike (sales): Approved the temporary override cost up to $1200 for the two-hour window. Please attach cost estimate when done.
Devon (eng-sre): Applying the override now. Will monitor. 
capacity-bot: ACTION eu-west-2 override applied for org-lumina-42 | token_rate=200 | max_inflight=60 | expires=1769508434
Devon (eng-sre): Queue length has started to drop: 480 -> 310 -> 190 in 6m. avg_wait down to 12s.
Ajay (eng-infra): Added a temporary admission rule to limit per-model concurrency to reduce tail latencies for other tenants.
Devon (eng-sre): Note for postmortem: we should add a runway for EU demos—prewarm path or reserve burst capacity for pilot customers to avoid manual overrides.
Rebecca (customer-success): Customer reports demo proceeding smoothly. They said thanks to the team :tada:
Ana (support): Closing support escalation once override expires and we confirm metrics stable. Documenting the change in #infra-change-log.
Devon (eng-sre): Will open a followup to discuss pricing options for guaranteed demo bursts and prescriptive onboarding changes.
Mike (sales): Great work everyone. :thumbsup:
